name: check_room
description: Checks whether a room booking request can be available using whole minutes since midnight from 0 to 1440, blocked status, and existing bookings. This tool only checks availability and does not save or create a booking.

start.description: Requested start time in whole minutes since midnight.

end.description: Requested end time in whole minutes since midnight.

now.description: Current time in whole minutes since midnight.

blocked.description: Whether the room is currently blocked.
